LIMIT, stated plainly: this is the vocabulary of TWO forms at one moment. A newly published form may use a term neither contains, and this fixture will not know. Re-capture when the published set changes materially.

This fixture is the PUBLISHED kit (46 fields) because a legal-boundary check must read the wording the app actually ships. Two snapshots of one form, each chosen for what its test needs.
